title: CC for your next move
label: CLEARROUTE / DEVNET PRODUCT WALKTHROUGH
narration: Meet ClearRoute, a Canton Coin funding application for teams building on Canton. This walkthrough shows the current Devnet product and the intended transfer journey. We have verified the sender wallet connection. A complete transfer to a volunteer recipient is still pending.

title: Keep building. Reduce funding work.
label: THE PROBLEM
narration: Small teams need a way to request C C, get a funding decision, and track what happened. ClearRoute brings that work into one application. The first pilot focuses on controlled wallet top ups. Purchasing validator traffic is a separate operation.

title: Start at the public request page
label: ACTUAL APPLICATION SCREEN
narration: This is the actual public funding page. A builder can request Devnet Canton Coin without first creating a ClearRoute account. The form asks for a team name, contact email, full Canton Party I D, wallet provider, amount, and testing purpose. The page never asks for a private key.

title: Use the party linked to your wallet
label: RECIPIENT SETUP
narration: The recipient must use an onboarded Devnet wallet that can receive and accept Splice transfer offers. A party created in a participant console alone does not establish that capability. For a NODERS hosted wallet, the provider field can say NODERS slash Splice wallet. The first planned test is one C C.

title: A request is reviewed before sending
label: OPERATOR WORKFLOW / EXPLAINED
narration: The operator opens Demo transfers, checks the treasury wallet, and reviews the request. The operator verifies the recipient and records an approval decision. The pilot allows up to ten C C per request and one hundred C C of total reserved or delivered exposure, excluding fees. Approval itself does not transfer coins.

title: The recipient accepts in their wallet
label: TRANSFER WORKFLOW / NOT YET DEMONSTRATED LIVE
narration: After approval and enabling sends, the operator submits a tracked transfer offer. The recipient opens their own wallet, verifies the sender and amount, and accepts. ClearRoute checks the original transfer status. If the outcome is uncertain, it reconciles that same transfer rather than submitting another payment. This sequence still needs a volunteer wallet for a complete live demonstration.

title: Evidence before confirmation
label: WHAT COUNTS AS SUCCESS
narration: Success means the application shows C C delivered with the wallet reported transaction reference, and the recipient confirms receipt. A click on Send, an approval, or a balance change alone is not our completion criterion. This video does not claim a completed native C C transfer.

title: What is verified, and what remains
label: CURRENT BUILD STATUS
narration: The latest verification run passed ninety one backend tests and forty three frontend tests, followed by the production build. The sender wallet identity, Devnet connection, and balance check also passed. Public pilot requests remain separate from the signed in customer funding page and billing. They are free Devnet tests and do not automatically create invoices.

title: Help test the next step
label: JOIN THE CLEARROUTE DEVNET PILOT
narration: We are looking for one volunteer with a compatible NODERS Devnet wallet to receive a one C C test offer. Share only your full wallet Party I D and wallet provider. Never share passwords or tokens. ClearRoute helps builders request funding and track delivery. Visit the project repository linked in the description, and contact the builder to join the pilot.
